tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Check a contract address on Robinhood Chain before buying, holding or accepting it: a token in Robinhood's list, a known look-alike, or unknown. Free, and about identity only: for a listed token's supply, multiplier and integrity flags, use get_token_summary. A look-alike answer names the token it i

tools.name: list_address_issuers
tools.description: List every issuer whose published token list includes an EVM address, one match per chain: Coinbase's tokenized stocks on Base, Robinhood's Stock Tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ondo Global Markets and xStocks on Ethereum and BNB Chain. Free. An address on no list gets the look-alike catalogue's answer,

tools.name: find_token
tools.description: Find the contract address of a stock token on Robinhood Chain by ticker or company name, before an agent buys it. Free. Use it when you have a name, not an address; to check an address you already have, use check_address. Returns Robinhood's tokens with the look-alikes pegproof knows of, then other

tools.name: get_token_summary
tools.description: Get a Robinhood stock token's current on-chain state: total supply, treasury balance, multiplier, ledger coverage, open integrity flags and the look-alikes pegproof knows of. history is the hourly check of its supply against its full mint and burn history: status (match, mismatch or ledger-behind),

tools.name: list_token_events
tools.description: List the events that created or destroyed a Robinhood stock token's supply: every mint, burn, issue and redeem, newest first. tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List integrity incidents across all of Robinhood's stock tokens, newest first: one call to monitor them all. An incident is a token whose supply or treasury balance diverged from its full mint/burn ledger, or a ledger rebaseline, with its type, status and block window. type=integrity (default), oper

tools.name: get_token_snapshot
tools.description: Get a Robinhood stock token's state at a past block: total supply, treasury balance and multiplier from the newest confirmed snapshot at or before it.
